name: Mr Norms
description: Norms is a lively karaoke bar known for its welcoming atmosphere and great music. It offers a fun environment where guests can sing, dance, and enjoy good vibes with friendly staff and diverse crowds. The venue is praised for its strong sound system, engaging karaoke nights available every night, and a community feel that makes everyone feel like family. Perfect for both casual nights out and special gatherings, Norms stands out as a go-to spot for karaoke lovers.
